summary: Iteration 5 backend testing: validated dashboard, product cost breakdown/live recompute, product-linked order auto-fill, PATCH stock deduction with idempotency, non-existent order 404, customer credit-sale/payment amount>0 validation, customer history & summary aggregation. All 9 pytest tests passed against public API.

minor.issue: Idempotency check relies on order.status != 'Tamamlandı'; if a completed order is re-sent Tamamlandı it correctly returns empty stock_updates but still writes completed_at again. Not a bug, but reset of completed_at could be avoided when status unchanged.
calc_product_cost re-queries materials collection for every product (O(N*M) DB calls). For large catalogs consider a single fetch/cached map per request.
Stock deduction is not transactional; partial failure mid-loop can leave stock inconsistent. Consider bulk operations or a compensating write on error.
amount defaults to 0 (ge=0). If user passes amount=0 explicitly for a product-linked order, code treats it as missing and auto-fills. Acceptable but ambiguous; a None default would be clearer.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes Order/Customer/Material/Product/Transaction models & endpoints in one file (~315 lines) - manageable now but split when it grows past ~500 lines.
No PATCH/PUT endpoints for materials or products; users can't adjust stock or unit_cost after creation without direct DB edits. Add PATCH endpoints.
PATCH /api/orders stock deduction is not atomic across materials; if one update fails the previous deductions remain (no rollback).
customer_summary and dashboard queries fetch all documents into memory with hard-coded limits (500/2000). For larger datasets convert to aggregation pipelines.
Missing DELETE endpoints for materials/products/customers/orders (soft-delete or hard) - previous iterations may have required these.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed material_a, material_b, product (TEST_Masa), customer (TEST_MusteriX), one order and one credit-sale + payment. Not cleaned up (no DELETE endpoints exist).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All targeted backend features from iteration 5 review request pass. Test DB has TEST_ prefixed leftover documents. If material PATCH/DELETE endpoints are added later, extend test_iteration5.py to verify live cost recomputation truly reflects unit_cost changes (currently only structure is asserted since no update endpoint exists).
